instruction:
look at `usb_breakout.brd` in the EAGLE board editor. The board has 4 SMD pads forming two unrouted signal pairs: USB_DP (pads at (10, 20) and (30, 20)) and USB_DM (pads at (10, 15) and (30, 15)). No copper wire currently exists on either net. Your job: use the ROUTE command (or draw wires on layer 1 / Top) to connect each signal's two pads, choosing route shapes whose total lengths are equal within 0.5 mm (this is a length-matched differential pair).

Requirements:
1. The file parses as XML.
2. Both USB_DP and USB_DM signals exist.
3. Each signal has >= 1 <wire> child on a copper layer (layer 1 or 16).
4. The sum of <wire> segment lengths per signal differs by <= 0.5 mm between USB_DP and USB_DM.
